capabilities: expand shorthand references like 太5 6 into full CUV verse quotes
extend or shrink verse ranges with Alt+] and Alt+[
browse the Bible in a right-sidebar reader with book and chapter pickers
jump from a reference in a note to the matching verse in the panel
read offline using bundled CUV data
extras: Bundles complete CUV Bible data (~1.1MB compressed) so it works offline after installation; README is bilingual (Chinese and English) and notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert Bible verses from short references or read scripture alongside notes.
summary: Bible study plugin that expands simplified Chinese verse references into CUV quotations and provides a sidebar Bible reading panel.
